title: Personal Needs Allowance Held Back from Resident Funds Withdrawals
content:
When the spare amount of a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account is worked out for a withdrawal, **the resident's allowance kept** is held back from it. The allowance kept follows the resident's case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage:

| Medical Assistance case | Allowance kept |
|---|---|
| eligible, in the Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, VA Reduced Pension tier | the personal needs allowance plus the protected VA pension of that tier |
| eligible, in any other tier | the personal needs allowance of the case's tier |
| not eligible, or no case | nothing |

The figures are the monthly personal needs allowance and the monthly protected VA pension amount that the case's tier carries under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage.

## Points of judgement

- A case that is pending, denied or closed keeps nothing back.
- A case eligible in the Community Spouse Allowance tier keeps back the personal needs allowance only; the protected VA pension is added only in the VA Reduced Pension tier.
